Name: Yunfish
Author: Blue6erry
Description:
[size=4][b]Say Hello to the Yunfish[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod was inspired by Yuy_IX and her chat. Mostly just her chat making fun of her[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Mechanics[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]The Yunfish can be found an any vanilla ocean, all seasons, between 12 PM and 5 PM[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]It is practically worthless[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]It is relatively rare so it doesn't tank ocean fishing[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Almost universally hated[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Horribly poisonous[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Fish Pond[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Mostly useless[/color][/size][/*]
[*]If you Tier 3 sub, there is a chance you become the paid chatter of the day[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Only in vanilla locations[/*]
[*]Should be compatible will all other mods[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Future[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Feel free to give me suggestion or feedback[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]The sprites aren't the best, if someone was inspired to redraw them, please do[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]If there is a new update and the mod is abandoned for a couple of months, you have my permission to reupload it[/color][/size][/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Yunfish
Manifest.Description: Everyone's favorite bitter and parasite-ridden flat vtuber is now in the valley in her true form
Manifest.Author: Blue6erry
